correctness.rationale: The central factorization is an identity of group ring words in a class-two group. All central factors lie in (2,1+s); the proved integer identity u^(2m)=2^(m-1)(2s^m+(1+s^2)(u^m-s^m)) implies that ideal has zero (2h+2)nd power modulo 2^h. An order-four group commutator supplies repeated generator factors, and reduction modulo two of u^(2h+1)/2^(h-1) is -s^h u^3, nonzero. Thus J_(2h+2) nonzero and J_(2h+3) zero for all h >=1, even for infinite G and any coefficient ring of exact characteristic 2^h. Exact verification script checks h=1..8 and Heisenberg group h=2.
